_comment_purpose: Lighthouse CI config — controls how Chrome audits the site during the GitHub Actions run.
_comment_collect: How Lighthouse should fetch the page: spin up a static server in the repo root, hit '/' three times, average the runs (smooths out jitter on shared CI runners).
_comment_assert: Score thresholds. We use 'warn' (not 'error') so tiny perf wobbles do not block PRs. Bump to 'error' once the scores are stable.
_comment_upload: Where the report goes. temporaryPublicStorage uploads to a free public viewer that the workflow prints a link to.
